title: אבו ע'וש - 1968 (Abu Ghosh, Neolithic site)
author: G. Dollfus and M. Lechevallier
screen_note: Spelling variant: 'אבו ע'וש' for the gazetteer's 'אבו גוש' (exploratory variant match).
location_note: Abu Ghosh Neolithic site; no map reference.
notes: Houses of the Pre-Pottery Neolithic B horizon; a large trench with Byzantine sherds. Tier-1 volume: extraction committed first (tier1_HA28-29_extraction.md).

features.subtype: burials under house floors (adult in house 1, two children in house 2), contracted
features.quote: נחשפו שלושה שלדי אדם כולם בתנוחה מכווצת

title: ירושלים: סקר בכפר השילוח (Jerusalem, survey in the village of Silwan)
author: D. Ussishkin (with G. Barkay)
location_note: Silwan village, east slope of the Kidron opposite the City of David; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Monolithic tombs: 'Tomb of Pharaoh's Daughter' (rock-cut pyramid destroyed by later quarrying), the '...yahu asher al ha-bayit' tomb (two chambers) and a third monolith with a Hebrew inscription, about 5.25 m wide and 4.23 m high, now a cistern under a courtyard. No facade orientation stated.

features.subtype: rock-cut tombs in the cliffs: gabled-ceiling, flat-ceiling and monolithic tombs; trough-shaped burial benches
features.period: First Temple period (Iron Age II); damaged in the Roman and Byzantine periods
features.quote: בתקופת הבית הראשון נוצלו מצוקים אלו לחציבת מערות קברים

features.subtype: tomb caves converted to water cisterns, including the third monolith now under a courtyard
features.period: after the village was built (later than the Byzantine monks' use)
features.quote: מערות קברים הפכו לבורות מים בורות ביוב מחסנים ולולים

title: ירושלים: "מערת האשכולות" (Jerusalem, Cave of the Grapes)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: North-east Jerusalem, near the Sanhedriya garden; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Facade with carvings below the lintel cleared; interior not cleaned; no date given.

features.subtype: rock-cut tomb with carved facade ('Cave of the Grapes')
features.quote: החזית שהיתה מכוסה באדמה נראית עתה בכל הדרה

title: ירושלים: מערות ברחוב שמואל הנביא (Jerusalem, caves in Shmuel ha-Navi Street)
author: (district archaeologist)
location_note: Shmuel ha-Navi Street, corner of Yehezkel Street; no map reference.
notes: Tier-1 volume (extraction committed first). Tomb 1: 19 ossuaries, two coins of the procurators of the 50s CE. Tomb system 2: three units, kokhim and arcosolia; a vertical entrance from the courtyard into a pit closed with a blocking stone; later dwellings with Early Arab pottery.

features.subtype: kokhim cave with 19 ossuaries; second tomb system with kokhim and arcosolia
features.period: end of the Second Temple period (coins of the procurators, 50s CE)
features.quote: זאת מערת כוכים מהטיפוס הנפוץ בסוף ימי הבית השני

features.subtype: courtyard opening of tomb system 2 used as a water cistern
features.period: in the last period of use (cave dwellings; pottery almost all Early Arab); earlier use unclear
features.quote: הפתח בחצר שימש כבור מים בתקופה האחרונה

title: פעולות שימור: ירושלים (conservation: Jerusalem city walls)
author: (Jerusalem municipality and Department of Antiquities)
location_note: Old City walls; sub-item of the conservation report.
notes: Sub-item of 'פעולות שימור' (TOC item 30). City walls only; no feature of the eligible classes.

title: הרודיון (Herodium)
author: G. Foerster
location_note: Herodium, upper palace; no map reference.
notes: Conservation of the palace excavated by V. Corbo 1963-1967 (peristyle, bath house and frigidarium dome); small finds (ostraca, coins, stone vessels, arrowheads, ballista stones). No feature of the eligible classes described.

title: ח' תאנאניר ליד שכם (Kh. Tananir near Shechem)
author: R. Boling
screen_note: Gazetteer: 'שכם' in the title; spelling 'תאנאניר' is a variant of the gazetteer's 'תנניר'.
location_note: On the lower slopes of Mount Gerizim (text); no map reference.
tier1_record: HA 28-29 (Tananir), arrival register README step 5; read after the freeze; extraction only (part_a/tier1_HA28-29_extraction.md, committed before this coding)
notes: Square building first found by the German expedition in 1931, dated by floor and foundation-trench finds to Middle Canaanite II B III, cultic. A small round structure about 200 m west of the main building (not eligible). Ribbed sherds, stone tesserae and walls indicate Roman-Byzantine building; the report does not tie this date to the pool. No dimensions or orientation for the pit or the pool.

features.subtype: large round pit (בור) in a room of an earlier building under the north wall of the square temple, partly built of stones and plaster, partly rock-cut; function not stated
features.period: Middle Canaanite II B III (jars, lamps and bowls at the bottom)
features.quote: באחד משלושת חדריו נחשף בור עגול גדול

features.subtype: rectangular rock-cut plastered pool about 50 m west of the main building, beside a levelled rock surface
features.quote: נמצאה בריכה מלבנית חצובה בסלע וטוחה
